fflate 0.8.2, MIT, https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
Upstream source: https://unpkg.com/fflate@0.8.2/esm/browser.js
zip-inflate.js contains the initial inflate decoder dependency section plus a bounded synchronous wrapper. Unused compression, worker and network helpers are excluded. Literal and backreference writes have explicit fixed-output bounds. Full upstream source is retained here for review.
